hunt.justification: Fileless execution is a primary method for evading traditional EDRs that scan files at write/execute time. A negative hunt result provides assurance that no persistent implants are active in memory across the Linux estate.

scenario.summary: This scenario reproduces five distinct Linux fileless execution patterns used to minimize on-disk artifacts and bypass file-based security controls. The techniques involve the use of anonymous memory-backed file descriptors via memfd_create, interpreter-based one-liners, unlinked (deleted) executable execution, and in-memory kernel module loading.

meta.rationale: Focus on servers and high-uptime Linux instances where memory-resident persistence is most effective. Exclude ephemeral container hosts unless testing CI/CD staging.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary is executing payloads through anonymous memory descriptors (memfd_create) or unlinking binaries immediately after launch to evade on-disk scanning and durable detection.

hunt.name: Linux Memory-Resident Execution and Evasion
hunt.description: This hunt identifies fileless execution patterns on Linux by detecting processes running without a corresponding binary on disk (on_disk = 0), identifying processes executing from '/proc' or 'memfd' paths, and finding kernel modules loaded from anonymous memory. It correlates this behavior with fleet-wide prevalence to distinguish legitimate administrative activity from malicious implants such as VoidLink.

config.scoping_notes: Focus on servers and high-uptime Linux instances where memory-resident persistence is most effective. Exclude ephemeral container hosts unless testing CI/CD staging.
config.beyond_detection: While a rule can alert on 'on_disk=0', this hunt uses fleet-wide prevalence and pivots across process and module loading surfaces to filter out container runtime noise and identify kernel-level evasion.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_path, process_cmd_line, pid, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (on_disk = 0 OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE 'memfd:%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '/proc/%/fd/%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find processes currently running where the binary is missing or the path indicates execution from an anonymous memory descriptor.
config.expected_signal: Rows naming processes running without disk artifacts. Legitimate container runtimes or updaters may appear, requiring prevalence analysis.

primitive_config.label: Identify Diskless or Descriptor-Based Processes
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_path, process_cmd_line, pid, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (on_disk = 0 OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE 'memfd:%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '/proc/%/fd/%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Rows naming processes running without disk artifacts. Legitimate container runtimes or updaters may appear, requiring prevalence analysis.

config.content: SELECT process_path, process_cmd_line, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE on_disk = 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY process_path, process_cmd_line HAVING hosts <= 3 ORDER BY hosts ASC
config.description: Stack-count processes running from memory to highlight unique or rare binaries that differ from standard fleet-wide software.
config.expected_signal: A diskless process seen on only 1 or 2 hosts is a strong indicator of a targeted payload.

primitive_config.label: Prevalence of Diskless Binaries
primitive_config.content: SELECT process_path, process_cmd_line, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS hosts, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE on_disk = 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY process_path, process_cmd_line HAVING hosts <= 3 ORDER BY hosts ASC
primitive_config.expected: A diskless process seen on only 1 or 2 hosts is a strong indicator of a targeted payload.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_path, process_cmd_line, pid, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%(deleted)%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%(deleted)%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Identify binaries that were deleted immediately after execution, leaving '(deleted)' markers in their path.
config.expected_signal: Rows indicating processes unlinked from disk, a common evasion tactic to prevent binary analysis.

primitive_config.label: Processes from Unlinked Paths
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, process_name, process_path, process_cmd_line, pid, time FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%(deleted)%' OR LOWER(process_name) LIKE '%(deleted)%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
primitive_config.expected: Rows indicating processes unlinked from disk, a common evasion tactic to prevent binary analysis.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, module_path, process_name, pid, time FROM hb_module_activity WHERE (LOWER(module_path) LIKE 'memfd:%' OR LOWER(module_path) LIKE '/proc/%') AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.description: Find loadable kernel modules (LKMs) sourced from memory or anonymous file descriptors rather than on-disk .ko files.
config.expected_signal: Kernel modules loaded from descriptors or memfd. This is a very high-confidence indicator of kernel-level fileless persistence.

config.objective: Determine if any host shows evidence of malicious fileless execution by weighing the 'on_disk=0' flag, rare prevalence, and memory-loaded modules.
config.description: Determine if the observed diskless processes or modules indicate a malicious implant or legitimate administrative activity.
config.expected_signal: A verdict characterizing the severity and intent of the diskless activity.
config.success_criteria: A per-host verdict of malicious | suspicious | benign, citing the specific process PIDs and paths.

config.question: the triage verdict is malicious for at least one host
config.condition: the triage verdict is malicious for at least one host
config.description: Escalate malicious findings for isolation or analyst review.
Contain the host to prevent lateral movement and preserve the memory of the fileless payload.
config.instructions: Isolate the host. Before a full reboot, attempt to dump the memory of the suspicious PID identified in triage to recover the ELF payload from memfd or procfs.

config.description: Manually confirm the findings and perform forensic extraction from memory.
config.instructions: Review the triage results. Use the identified PID to inspect /proc/<pid>/fd/ to recover the memfd payload, or /proc/<pid>/exe if it was deleted. Document if the activity corresponds to a legitimate administrative process to tune the baseline.

config.description: Archive the hunt results and tune future iterations.
config.instructions: Record whether any malicious activity was found. If the results were negative, confirm that the relevant surfaces had adequate coverage for the Linux estate.
